verdict.rationale: Ollama states that prompts are never tracked or trained on, and that nothing run locally ever leaves the machine. Users are excluded from training by default, with no opt-out needed, and running locally keeps data on-device. The evidence is homepage marketing one-liners, not a detailed policy. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training claim, and detailed first-party privacy-policy or data-retention terms covering Ollama Cloud usage.
